name: chkltlabs/laravel-porthole
description: Authenticated, read-only Model Context Protocol server for Laravel Horizon, Pulse, and Telescope.

suggest.filament/filament: Optional. Filament 4 or 5 renders the OAuth consent page with the panel's simple layout.
suggest.inertiajs/inertia-laravel: Optional. React, Vue, and Svelte starter kits render the OAuth consent page through Inertia.
suggest.livewire/flux: Optional. The Livewire starter kit renders the OAuth consent page with Flux.
suggest.laravel/horizon: Required to register the Horizon tools.
suggest.laravel/pulse: Required to register the Pulse tools.
suggest.laravel/sanctum: Bearer-token authentication for the HTTP MCP server.
suggest.laravel/telescope: Required to register the Telescope tools.
